data.one_liner: Tencent TDesign UI component library for Flutter mobile and web projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive cross-platform UI component library based on Tencent's design system. It includes pre-built mobile components, theme customization capabilities, and an icon library.
use_when: You want to build an application following Tencent's TDesign specifications.
You need a rich set of pre-built UI components for mobile and web apps in Flutter.
avoid_when: You are strictly using standard Material Design or Cupertino style guides without wanting custom Tencent design tokens.
You are on a Flutter version older than 3.32.0.
strengths: Rich set of pre-built components and theme customization options.
Includes a custom icon library and color tokens.
weaknesses: Documentation and guides are largely in Chinese.
Major versions introduce breaking changes requiring careful upgrades.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and require Flutter >= 3.32.0 and Dart >= 3.8.0.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Google Material Design components.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer native Apple iOS style design components.
